name: @corsair-dev/gitea
description: Gitea integration for Corsair: git hosting on Gitea, Forgejo and Codeberg (gitea.com or any self-hosted instance): repositories, branches and protections, commits and statuses, files, tags and releases, issues, comments, labels, milestones and time tracking, pull requests and reviews, wikis, projects, Actions (runs, jobs, artifacts, secrets, variables, runners, workflows), packages, organizations and teams, users, keys, notifications and site admin, plus signed webhooks for pushes, issues, pull requests, reviews and releases (530 operations).
author: Corsair (https://corsair.dev)
